events.title: We are back! What we've been working on.
events.summary: Hi all!It's been over a month since our last dev log. First, a huge thank you to everyone who played the Vibe Train Demo during Steam Train Fest. events.title: Vibe Train is participating in the Steam Train Fest!
events.summary: All aboard! Steam Train Fest is now open through July 27! To celebrate the occasion, we’ve added two new vehicles to the game:festive train enginefestive passenger carBoth are available for free. Once you have visited Dawn City Station, they will be delivered to you automatically. Whether you’re discovering Vibe Train for the first time or returning for another journey, we hope you’ll stop by, try the demo, and take the new train for a ride!Enjoy Steam Train Fest!
